newsitem.title: USA: MOF's Kubo to hold insurance briefing at 0345 GMT.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Kubo to hold insurance briefing at 0345 GMT.

text.p: Finance Minister Wataru Kubo plans to hold a news conference on Japan's insurance dispute with the United States at 11.45 p.m. on Monday eastern standard time (0345 GMT Tuesday), a Japanese government official said.
The official did not elaborate on what the news conference would be about.
Kubo met U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky on Sunday to discuss the simmering bilateral dispute on insurance, but they remained far apart on the issues, another official said.
The United States has argued that Tokyo is poised to renege on a 1994 insurance trade pact.
Japan announced on Monday that it would delay the entry of domestic insurance companies into a sector especially profitable to foreign firms.
